title: Something showed up in the mid-2000s that changed the game

tellings.quote: I think something happened in the mid 2000s that changed the game. I think something showed up that we were not tracking.

plain: Something appeared around the middle of the 2000s that the United States was not tracking, and it changed the game. That is the view of a guest named Dylan Borland, who says a top government official once told him that aliens run everything, and he offers it to Jesse Michels as his own belief rather than a described event. If he is right, the government's handling of the subject would have shifted around that time.
